title: Stranger Peeps: A Podcast About Stranger Things
author: Lucy & Iris
description: Two best friends and super fans of Stranger Things, Lucy and Iris, are doing a rewatch of Stranger Things (for the millionth time) and telling you everything they know, details you might have missed, and different opinions and theories about Stranger Things. New episodes every Monday at 5 PM ET. Catch you in the Upside Down!
